strategy.thesis: Korea's first 100% city-government-owned public venture capital, established by Daejeon City to fund regional promising companies and revitalize the local venture ecosystem so startups do not need to relocate to Seoul.

summary.en: Daejeon Investment Finance (founded July 2024) is Korea's first wholly city-owned public venture capital, set up by Daejeon City. It anchors the KRW 204.8 billion 'Daejeon D-Leap Fund' (Korea's first/largest local-government public-private mother fund) to invest in regional companies, primarily Series A and later.

summary.en: Korea Science & Technology Holdings (KST, founded Nov 2013) is a Daejeon-based public technology-holding company / deep-tech company builder, jointly established by 17 government research institutes with KRW 50.4 billion capital. It commercializes national R&D by spinning out and growing deep-tech subsidiaries.
summary.local: 한국과학기술지주(KST, 2013년 11월 설립)는 대전 소재 공공 기술지주회사·딥테크 컴퍼니빌더로, 17개 정부출연연구기관이 자본금 504억원을 공동출자해 설립했다. 국가 R&D 성과를 사업화해 딥테크 자회사를 설립·육성한다.

strategy.thesis: Jeju's first private accelerator, specializing in cultural-content-convergence startups; discovers and educates early founders through its LOG+ program and coworking space, then seeds them via its own investment fund.

program.eligibility: Pre-startup teams and early-stage startups, content-convergence focus, Jeju region

summary.en: BridgeSquare (legal name TAPL, founded 2020) is Jeju's first private accelerator, specializing in cultural-content-convergence startups. It runs the LOG+ program with a 6-month incubation plus 6-month acceleration cycle, seeds startups via its own fund, and has 8 disclosed portfolio companies.
summary.local: 브릿지스퀘어(법인명 테이플, 2020년 설립)는 제주 첫 민간 액셀러레이터로 문화콘텐츠 융합 스타트업에 특화돼 있다. 6개월 보육 + 6개월 액셀러레이팅의 LOG+ 프로그램을 운영하고 자체 펀드로 시드 투자하며 8개 포트폴리오를 보유한다.

strategy.thesis: Jeju-based blockchain-specialized accelerator, founded by core ICON Foundation members and ad-tech firm AD4th, to discover and invest in blockchain startups and provide ICON-infrastructure support, office space and joint business-model development.

summary.en: Deblock (founded April 2018) is a Jeju-based blockchain-specialized accelerator, set up by core ICON Foundation members and ad-tech firm AD4th. It discovers and invests in blockchain startups (e.g. Weblock) and provides ICON infrastructure, workspace and joint BM development.
summary.local: 디블락(2018년 4월 설립)은 제주 거점 블록체인 전문 액셀러레이터로, 아이콘 재단 핵심 인력과 애드테크 기업 애드포스가 공동 설립했다. 블록체인 스타트업(예: 위블락)을 발굴·투자하고 ICON 인프라·사무공간·BM 공동개발을 지원한다.
